newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Morgan Stanley names Asia inv banking chief.
newsitem.headline: Morgan Stanley names Asia inv banking chief.

text.p: Investment bank Morgan Stanley said on Tuesday it had appointed Spencer Fleischer as head of investment banking in non-Japan Asia.
Fleischer is currently a managing director with Morgan Stanley in London, where he is head of corporate financing for the European region, the company said in a statement.
He will relocate to Hong Kong toward the middle of the year but will spend much time in the territory in the interim.

Fleischer's responsibilities in Europe will be assumed by Michael Uva, currently a managing director and head of Morgan Stanley's European Telecommunications Group withing the Investment Banking division, Morgan Stanley said.
